description: Deletes one evidence (a logical delete). Irreversible from the MCP. The platform allows it only when the evidence is COMPLETED, is still waiting for its file (INTERNAL custody, bytes not uploaded yet), or a required timestamp ended in ERROR; it refuses while the evidence is being processed and when it is under, or entering, qualified archiving. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId, evidence_group_create → evidenceGroupId, and evidence_create → evidenceId passed as id. Returns no body.
name: evidence_delete
